issue_context.title: [BUG] No quotes around show-trace path when test fails and path has spaces
issue_context.body:
### System info
- Playwright Version: [v1.41.0]
- Operating System: [Windows 11]
- Browser: [Chromium]
- Other info:

**Steps**
- Make sure that you have a test in a folder that contains spaces
- Let the test fail

**Expected**

Being able to copy the message and paste it in a console. It should be: `npx playwright show-trace "test-results\page-01 - appointments-Create-chromium\trace.zip"`

**Actual**
 `npx playwright show-trace test-results\page-01 - appointments-Create-chromium\trace.zip`
The message doesn't have quotes around the path, causing it to give an error when you copy and paste the message

review_comments: nit: maybe print without quotes if path is in [\w\/\\]?
